title: Pocketwire Advance Past-Due Timeline by Tier
content:
Once a Pocketwire Advance line is past due, its tier sets how long it can stay so before it is suspended, when an unpaid balance is written off, how long a repaid suspended line waits before reinstatement, and how far the line drops at the next monthly review.

| Tier | Suspension after (calendar days past due) | Write-off after (calendar days past due) | Reinstatement wait after full repayment (calendar days) | Tiers dropped at the next monthly review after a past-due period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 30 | 120 | 30 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 30 | 120 | 30 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 30 | 120 | 30 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 45 | 120 | 30 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 45 | 150 | 14 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 60 | 180 | 14 | 2 |

## Timeline terms

- **Suspension after** — the calendar days after the line became past due at which it is suspended if still past due.
- **Write-off after** — the calendar days after the line became past due at which the unpaid balance is written off.
- **Reinstatement wait** — the calendar days after a suspended line was repaid in full before it can be reinstated.
- **Tiers dropped** — the number of tiers the line drops at the next monthly review after any past-due period in the previous month.

## Reading the timeline

On every tier the write-off point lies after the suspension point: on Pocketwire Advance Starter, Basic and Standard 30 and 120 days, on Pocketwire Advance Plus 45 and 120 days, on Pocketwire Advance Max 45 and 150 days, and on Pocketwire Advance Elite 60 and 180 days, all counted from the date the line became past due.
